sloka: अग्निहोत्रेषु तीर्थेषु चैत्य वृक्षेषु रावण ।अत्यन्त घोरो व्यचरन् तापसान् संप्रधर्षयन् ॥३-३९-४॥
transliteration: agnihotreṣu tīrtheṣu caitya vṛkṣeṣu rāvaṇa ।atyanta ghoro vyacaran tāpasān saṁpradharṣayan ॥3-39-4॥

translations.english: O Ravana, assuming a very dreadful form, I wandered about sacrificial spots, sacred places, river banks, under huge trees planted at quadranglestorturing the ascetics.
